data.title: Xi departs for US for talks with Trump
data.description: BEIJING - China’s leader Xi Jinping departed Beijing on Wednesday, bound for Washington where he will meet with US President Donald Trump, state media said

data.title: UK to revisit Chagos deal after Trump criticism
data.description: LONDON - Defence Secretary Wes Streeting said on Wednesday that Britain would rework its deal with Mauritius to return the remote Chagos Islands, home to a strategic US-UK military base, amid vocal opposition from President Donald Trump.

data.title: Azerbaijan pardons Frenchman after EU lifts sanctions on oligarchs
data.description: BAKU - Azerbaijan’s president on Wednesday pardoned Martin Ryan, a Frenchman jailed since 2023 on espionage charges, following the European Union’s removal of two Russian billionaires from its sanctions list.

data.title: Black Sea drone attacks spell terror for Turkish sailors
data.description: They’d just had breakfast when a huge blast brought the crew of the Turkish fishing boat racing out onto main deck, where they were standing when the second strike hit.

data.title: 'Super' El Niño could cause 451,000 excess deaths: research
data.description: SINGAPORE — Extreme ⁠heat ⁠caused by this year's "super-El ​Niño" could result in as many as 451,000 excess deaths ​across the globe in ‌the six months through February 2027, researchers with the University of Chicago's Climate Impact Lab said on Wednesday.

data.title: Canada judge to decide prison term for suicide poison seller
data.description: TORONTO (CANADA) - Relatives of people who committed suicide using poison sold by Canadian Kenneth Law will give statements this week to a judge tasked with deciding the former chef's prison term.

data.title: How does Xi Jinping’s ‘special plane’ compare with Air Force One?
data.description: HONG KONG — Ahead of Chinese President Xi Jinping's visit to Washington this week, attention is already turning to the aircraft that will carry him and how it stacks up against America's famous presidential plane.

data.title: Weinstein faces resentencing in New York for 2006 sex assault
data.description: NEW YORK - Disgraced movie mogul Harvey Weinstein, who was at the center of abuse allegations that spurred the MeToo movement in Hollywood, will be sentenced again Wednesday for sexually assaulting a former production assistant.

data.title: Trump met with Venezuela's interim leader at UN
data.description: NEW YORK - US President Donald Trump and Venezuela's interim leader Delcy Rodriguez met in person for the first time earlier this week and discussed topics like energy and security, she said.

data.title: Outgoing UN chief makes climate push at New York summit
data.description: UNITED NATIONS (UNITED STATES) - Fresh from accusing fossil fuel interests of treating the atmosphere like an "open sewer," outgoing UN chief Antonio Guterres is set to host his final climate summit at the world organization's New York headquarters.

data.title: AI risks, Iran war to take centre stage at UN
data.description: UNITED NATIONS (UNITED STATES) - The future of artificial intelligence (AI) and the stalled US war against Iran, with its ripple effect on the global economy, are expected to dominate the UN gathering of world leaders Wednesday.

data.title: Beatings, electric shocks, sexual violence: women endure torture in Myanmar prisons
data.description: Myanmar ​has more than 30,000 ⁠political prisoners ⁠since coup; over 6,600 women ​and 640 children among them

data.title: Mongolian herders enlist new tech against harsher, drier climate
data.description: CHOYR — When Mongolian herder Ganchimeg's sheep strayed dangerously near a salty lake this summer, driven by hunger as nearby vegetation was poor, she was in a "total panic".

data.title: In Cambodia's 'Waiting Village', tattooist mourns trade lost to war
data.description: RONG CHAM — More than 3,000 houses stand in neat rows across Rong Cham, a 400-hectare (990-acre) resettlement site dubbed by residents "the Waiting Village", where families who fled fighting along the Cambodia-Thailand border still wait to return home nine months after the ceasefire.

data.title: Football coach axed for telling female ref 'It's a man's game'
data.description: LOS ANGELES — Columbus Crew sacked Argentine reserve team coach Federico Higuain for telling a female referee "Don't forget this is a man's game" while refusing to release her from a handshake, the Major League Soccer (MLS) club said Tuesday.

data.title: AI political ads warp reality ahead of US midterms
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - A political ad depicts a US Senate hopeful remarking on God and gender while scrawling in a Bible with a crayon. But he never filmed the clip: it is yet another AI-generated video pushed by a rival ahead of the midterm elections.

data.title: Chile's Atacama Desert blossoms with life after El Nino rains
data.description: CHILE - A resplendent display of flowers has bloomed across Chile's Atacama Desert, one of the driest places on earth, after the El Nino climate phenomenon brought heavy rain to the region.

data.title: French prosecutors probe secret filming of women with smart glasses
data.description: PARIS — Paris prosecutors said they have opened several probes after receiving complaints concerning women filmed on the street without their consent using smart glasses.

data.title: Australia PM says draft social media rules about taking back control
data.description: SYDNEY - Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese defended new draft social media regulations after Washington warned the draft legislation could lead to censorship.

data.title: Moldova declares energy, water emergency
data.description: CHISINAU - Moldova's parliament on Tuesday voted to introduce a 60-day state of emergency in the energy and water sectors as the country faces rising fuel prices and a severe drought.
